original.alt: Snappy — torch raised, ready to illuminate whatever you need to launch.

cloak-and-torch.alt: Snappy in a brown cloak with a satchel — the original flame-keeper, lighting the path to your apps.

torchbearer.alt: Snappy holding the torch aloft — every command finds its path.

torchbearer-backpack.alt: Snappy with a full pack and a lit torch — always prepared for the next launch.

explorer-cartographer.alt: Snappy charting unknown territory — compass, scroll, lantern, and a torch for good measure. No app goes unlaunched.

cloak-and-lantern.alt: Snappy carrying both a torch and a lantern — double the light, double the launches.

lamp-and-staff-explorer.alt: Snappy with a walking staff and a lantern — every expedition deserves a quick launcher.

rugged-explorer.alt: Snappy field-tested and torch-lit — goggles up, map in hand, ready to launch anything.

whip-and-torch-explorer.alt: Snappy on a relic hunt — apps. Why did it have to be apps?

gold-miner.alt: Snappy panning for pixel gold — the torch lights the way to buried commands.

yellow-chomping-ghost.alt: Snappy in a yellow chomping costume — wakka wakka wakka, app launched.

yellow-chomping-ghost-2.alt: Snappy in full chomping mode — the power pellet was a quick launch all along.

werewolf.alt: Snappy after that unfortunate bite — sharper claws, same dedication to launching on command.

werewolf-moon.alt: Snappy howling at the full moon — the launches must flow.

iron-circuit.alt: Snappy encased in glowing dark armor — the arc in its chest is just a very bright torch.

party.alt: Snappy ringing in the occasion — confetti optional, launch mandatory.

easter-bunny-nest.alt: Snappy in a hay nest with bunny ears — some apps are harder to find than others.

easter-bunny-flowers.alt: Snappy amid spring blooms, ears on — the hunt is afoot.

easter-bunny-wreath.alt: Snappy with a full flower wreath and a cracked egg — the season has officially started.

santa.alt: Snappy delivering gifts and app launches — checking the list twice.

halloween-witch-pumpkins.alt: Snappy in a witch hat amid carved pumpkins — trick or launch.

halloween-witch-lantern.alt: Snappy with a glowing jack-o-lantern bucket — carrying the light into the night.

steampunk.alt: Snappy from the age of brass and steam — pocket watch, goggles, and a cane for good measure.

steampunk-aviator.alt: Snappy in brass gear and aviator goggles — mechanically inclined to launch everything.

black-coat-shades.alt: Snappy in a black leather coat and oval sunglasses — there is no launcher. There never was.

black-coat-shades-2.alt: Snappy in the coat, leaning — you can feel the render distance increasing.

red-pill-blue-pill.alt: Snappy holding a glowing choice — one pill launches the app, the other lets you keep searching.

black-coat-shades-3.alt: Snappy in full black on a reflective surface — the agents are aware of the launcher.

fire-wizard-star.alt: Snappy in a star-emblemed wizard hat with a flaming wand — the spell was always a launch command.

fire-mage.alt: Snappy wielding fire in both hands — the torch was just the beginning.

proton-pack-buster-nsfw.alt: Snappy suited up with a proton pack — who you gonna call when the app won't launch?

proton-pack-buster-2-nsfw.alt: Snappy in ghost-hunting gear, goggles on — the readout is off the charts.

proton-pack-buster-3-nsfw.alt: Snappy locking in the proton stream — don't cross the beams. Or the launch commands.

scifi-scavenger-nsfw.alt: Snappy in tactical dark gear with a blaster — salvaging apps from the wreckage.

century-hopper-walkie.alt: Snappy in a puffer vest with a walkie and a glowing device — this launch command is from the future.

century-hopper-walkman.alt: Snappy with a cassette player and headphones — the roads where we're going don't need context.

boldly-go-gold.alt: Snappy in a gold starship uniform, communicator in hand — ready to boldly launch where no owl has launched before.

boldly-go-gold-nsfw.alt: Snappy in a gold starship uniform, phaser raised — set phasers to launch.

engage-crimson.alt: Snappy in a red starship uniform with a PADD — make it so.

engage-crimson-nsfw.alt: Snappy in a red starship uniform, phaser drawn — the app will be on screen in five seconds.

horned-trickster.alt: Snappy in golden horns and a green cloak, holding a scepter — burdened with glorious launching purpose.

horned-trickster-2.alt: Snappy in the horned helm, staff raised — glorious purpose, alternate angle.

hooded-blade-bearer-nsfw.alt: Snappy hooded in dark leather, golden sword drawn — the launcher must be protected.

time-wanderer-top-hat.alt: Snappy in a top hat and plaid cloak, sonic in hand — the one and only original. Grumpy, brilliant, unmistakable.

time-wanderer-pocket-watch.alt: Snappy with a pocket watch and a walking cane — playing second fiddle to no one, always on time to launch.

time-wanderer-mop-top.alt: Snappy with dark mop-top hair in a plaid waistcoat — the recorder was second only to the sonic, and the sonic always won.

time-wanderer-velvet-cape.alt: Snappy in a red-lined velvet cape with frilled cuffs — third time in exile, launching in elegant defiance.

time-wanderer-striped-scarf.alt: Snappy in a wide-brim hat with an impossibly long striped scarf — four jelly babies short, and twice as many apps to launch.

time-wanderer-striped-scarf-2.alt: Snappy in the iconic scarf, sonic raised — four pockets, all of them full of jelly babies and launch configs.

time-wanderer-striped-scarf-3.alt: Snappy in the wide-brim hat with four miles of scarf — same wanderer, rendered differently.

time-wanderer-cricket-whites.alt: Snappy in cricket whites and a decorated hat, holding a cricket ball — always taking five, sonic in one hand, launcher in the other.

time-wanderer-celery-lapel.alt: Snappy in cricket whites with a stick of celery on the lapel — the celery has five known uses. Not one of them is decorative.

time-wanderer-loud-coat.alt: Snappy in a gloriously loud waistcoat with an umbrella — a sixth sense for clashing colours, and an impeccable eye for launches.

time-wanderer-question-marks.alt: Snappy in a question-mark sweater with a curved umbrella — seven moves ahead and already launching the outcome.

time-wanderer-question-marks-2.alt: Snappy with a question-mark hat and a cane — seven schemes already in motion, different hat angle.

time-wanderer-forgotten.alt: Snappy as the unnumbered face — grizzled, battle-worn, launching what no one else would.

time-wanderer-waistcoat.alt: Snappy in a patterned waistcoat and dark coat, sonic raised — on cloud nine, and everything about it is fantastic.

time-wanderer-leather-jacket.alt: Snappy in a black leather jacket with a red V-neck — nine hundred years and still no time for accessories. Just launches.

time-wanderer-pinstripe.alt: Snappy in a brown pinstripe suit, glasses pushed up — a perfect ten. Allons-y.

time-wanderer-fez-and-bowtie.alt: Snappy in a fez with a red bow tie — turning it up to eleven. Fezzes are cool. So are quick launches.

time-wanderer-silver-sweep.alt: Snappy with swept silver hair in a dark navy coat — striking twelve with every entrance, launches like precision strikes.

time-wanderer-silver-sweep-2.alt: Snappy in silver and navy, sonic pointed forward — twelve centuries of disapproval. I am not a good owl. But the launches are impeccable.

time-wanderer-rainbow-stripe.alt: Snappy in a rainbow-stripe top and dungarees — a baker's dozen of apps launched before breakfast, fam.

time-wanderer-rainbow-stripe-2.alt: Snappy in the rainbow top, satchel on, sonic raised — thirteen items in the kit bag, all of them launch-ready.

time-wanderer-rainbow-stripe-3.alt: Snappy stepping forward in the rainbow-stripe outfit — thirteen destinations on the itinerary, and every single one needs a launcher.

time-wanderer-rainbow-stripe-4.alt: Snappy in the dungarees, satchel swung — baker's dozen of incarnations, and every single one eventually launches something.

dashing-captain.alt: Snappy in a military greatcoat with a roguish grin — it's all just a matter of timing the launch.

dashing-captain-nsfw.alt: Snappy in a military greatcoat, revolver raised — always pointing at something worth launching.

retro-computer-head.alt: Snappy wearing a CRT monitor as a head, floppy disk in hand — the original launch machine.

ninja-nsfw.alt: Snappy in full black ninja wrap with a katana on its back — the app was launched before you even noticed.

pirate-nsfw.alt: Snappy with a skull hat and a cutlass — X marks the launch target.

astronaut.alt: Snappy suited up for orbit — one small launch for an owl, one giant leap for owl-kind.

deep-sea-diver.alt: Snappy in a vintage brass diving suit — launching the deep web. Literally.

pixel-gamer-king.alt: Snappy with a pixelated crown and a Game Boy — the high score is the number of apps launched.

desert-force-wielder-nsfw.alt: Snappy in desert robes, hilt in hand — these aren't the apps you're looking for.

desert-force-wielder-2-nsfw.alt: Snappy in a hooded robe with an ignited blade — the force of a well-timed launch is strong with this one.

perfect-organism.alt: Snappy as the perfect organism — in darkness, no one can hear the launcher.

dreadlock-hunter-nsfw.alt: Snappy as a trophy-collecting hunter from the stars — if it installs, it can be launched.

adamantium-claw-berserker-nsfw.alt: Snappy with metal claws extended — the best there is at what it does, and what it does is launch apps.

automail-fire-alchemist.alt: Snappy bound by equivalent exchange — one command given, one app launched.

banana-goggle-minion.alt: Snappy in overalls with round goggles and a banana — LAUNCH! BA-NA-NA!

desert-face-wrapped-rider.alt: Snappy wrapped for the desert, goggles on — the launches must flow.

battle-scarred-cyborg.alt: Snappy half-machine with a glowing red eye — it'll be back. With a launch command.

battle-scarred-cyborg-nsfw.alt: Snappy as a battle-damaged cyborg, flaming gun raised — I need your launcher. Your commands. Your torch.

brave-little-astromech.alt: Snappy reimagined as a white-and-blue astromech — beeping urgently, holding all the launch commands.

cape-and-fangs.alt: Snappy in a high-collared cape with an amber gem — I vant to launch your applications.

cape-and-fangs-2.alt: Snappy in a dark winged cape — the night is long and there are many apps to launch.

cosmic-surfer-silver.alt: Snappy riding a silver board through the cosmos — the power to launch anything, anywhere.

daywalker-blade-nsfw.alt: Snappy half in shadow with a sword raised — some apps only get launched at night.

battle-helmet.alt: Snappy under a heavy combat helmet — suited up, launch ready.

clues-were-elementary.alt: Snappy in a deerstalker with a magnifying glass and a pipe — the launch was elementary.

clues-were-elementary-2.alt: Snappy on the case with glass, pipe, and pocket watch — the game is afoot. So is the app launcher.

hockey-mask-slasher-nsfw.alt: Snappy in a hockey mask with a very familiar blade — ch-ch-ch, launch-launch-launch.

striped-sweater-claw-nsfw.alt: Snappy with a battered hat and bladed glove — one, two, Snappy's launching it for you.

remember-remember-nsfw.alt: Snappy behind a grinning mask with a dagger — remember, remember to always launch in November.

lightning-bolt-scarlet.alt: Snappy in a scarlet suit surrounded by lightning — the fastest launcher alive.

orange-wing-pilot.alt: Snappy in an orange flight vest with a head bandage — the rebellion runs on quick launches.

orange-wing-pilot-nsfw.alt: Snappy in an orange flight vest, blaster raised — stay on target.

time-wanderer-bowtie-duster.alt: Snappy in a navy suit with a bow tie and open duster coat — a perfect ten in bow ties, and technically sonic.

sea-captain-lantern.alt: Snappy with a captain's hat, telescope, and lantern — navigating every app in the known waters.

whip-and-skull-torch.alt: Snappy with a whip and a skull-topped torch — fortune and glory, and a very specific keyboard shortcut.

flame-paladin-nsfw.alt: Snappy in a hooded cloak, flaming sword and shield raised — the launcher of righteousness stands ready.

relic-hunter-idol.alt: Snappy with goggles, a golden idol, and a torch — it belongs in the app catalogue.

forest-tunic-hero-nsfw.alt: Snappy in a green tunic with sword and triforce shield — it's dangerous to launch alone.

century-hopper-red-vest.alt: Snappy in a red puffer vest with a temporal gadget — where we're going, we don't need mouse clicks.

stone-gargoyle-battlement.alt: Snappy perched on a castle battlement, wings spread — guarding the launcher from above.

stone-gargoyle.alt: Snappy carved from stone with glowing wings — even gargoyles need a quick launcher.

stone-gargoyle-2.alt: Snappy in stone form, crouched and watchful — waiting for the next command.

stone-gargoyle-3.alt: Snappy as an ancient stone sentinel, wings wide — the command palette has been here all along.

jade-giant-rage.alt: Snappy gone jade and furious — the more apps you close, the angrier it gets.

mission-control.alt: Snappy in a mission officer's uniform with a headset — T-minus five seconds to launch.

mission-control-torch.alt: Snappy in a mission officer's uniform, torch in hand — all systems nominal, ready to launch.

mech-assault.alt: Snappy in the battle mech, weapons stowed — the suit alone is intimidating enough.

mech-assault-nsfw.alt: Snappy encased in full battle mech, guns raised — heavy ordnance, even heavier app library.

scarlet-merc.alt: Snappy in a red and black suit, finger pointing — maximum effort, maximum launches.

scarlet-merc-nsfw.alt: Snappy in the red suit with a katana on its back — the launcher is chimichanga-approved.

infinity-gauntlet-titan-nsfw.alt: Snappy in purple titanium armor, gauntlet raised — with a snap, half your open apps are gone.

stone-gargoyle-armored.alt: Snappy in ornate stone armor with a glowing chest gem — the ancient keeper of hotkeys.

proton-pack-buster.alt: Snappy in the proton-pack jumpsuit, ready but not firing — who you gonna call for a quick launch?

hooded-force-wanderer.alt: Snappy in a desert robe, lightsaber hilt at the belt — the force-sensitive approach to launching apps.

striped-sweater-fedora.alt: Snappy in the battered hat and striped sweater, hands empty — it knows what apps you want to run next.

remember-remember.alt: Snappy behind the grinning mask, no blade in sight — the fifth of November is always a good day to launch.

hockey-mask-slasher.alt: Snappy in the hockey mask, unarmed — ch-ch-ch... the launcher is already running.

gunslinger-trench-coat.alt: Snappy in a black trench coat with an ammo belt and sunglasses — loaded for bear, ready to launch.

dreadlock-hunter-2-nsfw.alt: Snappy in alien hunter armor, shoulder cannon primed — the launcher has been tracked, cornered, and deployed.

triangle-ops-nsfw.alt: Snappy in tactical gear with a glowing crystal token — field-tested, torch-lit, and cleared to launch.

triangle-ops-2-nsfw.alt: Snappy in battle-worn tactical gear with a headset and drawn weapon — patch me through, there's an app to launch.

cosmic-surfer-silver-2.alt: Snappy on the silver board, leaning into the cosmos — the board goes where the apps are.

lightning-bolt-scarlet-2.alt: Snappy in the scarlet suit, mid-stride — still the fastest launcher alive.
